summary: The tl.dot-in-runtime-loop class is repaired and at zero. Triage of the dead attempt-1 worker's uncommitted tree found its core repair sound (the staged-carries back-edge copy indexing by the element counter and the matrix region's induction override) but incomplete: I kept it and fixed the defect classes it exposed. (1) The register cache now follows the dominance rule: if-arms, loop bodies and matrix regions scope their lazily-materialized values, and _close_pass drops every chunk-body binding (constants and pure scalar trees -- including program_id, maxmin and address terms -- re-materialize at their next use); the liveout analysis now counts scalar-segment uses (the rng seed load). (2) _address_of adds the loop-exit offset register for a join use of a carried pointer (matmul_k32_persistent_n_2stage wrote tile 1 over tile 0 and left the last tile unwritten). (3) The staging analysis no longer clobbers a dot operand's native record on layout results, and the staging loop converts + unit-stride-stores native results (the transposed fp16 A of the matmul_at_b family wrote 32-bit lanes into the 16-bit IME region); native sources refuse located. (4) The carried end value inherits the init record's native convention; (5) float atomics derive their retry-loop blocks from the per-atomic tag (gemm_rowstats' sum+max pair branched into the first atomic's duplicate-named blocks); (6) the MIR verifier rejects duplicate block names; (7) the vmath scratch pair borrows caller-saved GPRs free at the call (fused_conv3d's erf); (8) emission refusals surface as located PipelineErrors. Final: the 44-operator sweep shows the class at zero (187 artifacts + 16 located refusals of other constructs, 0 crash/over-budget); 443+ execution rows PASS at 1 and 4 workers under the declared policies with positive smt.vmadot/smt.vfwmadot counts bound to k-loop artifacts; the T014 reproduction passes; every a100c test file passes. Remaining, recorded honestly: gqa segfaults at 1 worker with CSE on (CSE off, the plain driver, and 4 workers all PASS -- a CSE x matrix-region interaction, bisected, reproduction and trace recorded), and 16 identities refuse at three declared boundaries (block joins across dot-hosting ifs, multi-lane broadcasts inside non-restructured runtime regions, 16-bit atomics).
